data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task owns the default/floor sub-outcome of the following story done definition:
- dd-4 (sub-partition: default/floor helper behavior): Operators can override the call-site threshold via migration.call_site_threshold. This task owns ONLY the helper's default value, floor enforcement, and non-silent rejection of below-floor values. The override-effect boundary-crossing half of dd-4 (an override moving a borderline target across the classification boundary) is owned by task-3.

Add get_call_site_threshold() to plugins/dso/hooks/lib/planning-config.sh, mirroring the existing get_max_remediation_cycles() pattern: read migration.call_site_threshold from WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE, fall back to the documented default when unset, enforce a minimum floor, and reject below-floor values non-silently (non-zero exit + diagnostic on stderr) rather than silently clamping. Behavioral test lives at plugins/dso/tests/hooks/lib/test-planning-config-call-site-threshold.sh.

## TDD Test Spec
Given planning-config.sh sourced with WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE pointing at a config whose migration.call_site_threshold is set below the enforced floor; When get_call_site_threshold is invoked; Then it exits non-zero and writes a non-empty diagnostic to stderr (it never silently clamps to the floor). And: Given a config with migration.call_site_threshold set to a known valid value; When get_call_site_threshold is invoked; Then stdout equals that value verbatim. And: Given no migration.call_site_threshold key set; When invoked; Then stdout equals the documented default.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] AC1 (post-implementation GREEN gate): the call-site-threshold behavioral suite reports FAILED: 0 after the helper is implemented. NOTE: this is the GREEN gate — pre-implementation (RED) the suite MUST fail on the below-floor-rejection assertion (AC3).
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/hooks/lib/test-planning-config-call-site-threshold.sh | grep -qE 'FAILED:[[:space:]]*0'
- [ ] AC2 (override returns the configured value, execution-based): sourcing planning-config.sh, writing a temp config with migration.call_site_threshold set to a known value, and invoking get_call_site_threshold under WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE prints that value verbatim on stdout.
  Verify: cfg=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cst-ac2.XXXXXX"); printf 'migration:\n  call_site_threshold: 25\n' > "$cfg"; out=$( source plugins/dso/hooks/lib/planning-config.sh; WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$cfg" get_call_site_threshold ); rm -f "$cfg"; test "$out" = "25"
- [ ] AC3 (below-floor rejection is non-silent): writing a temp config with migration.call_site_threshold below the enforced floor and invoking get_call_site_threshold causes a non-zero exit AND a non-empty stderr diagnostic — it never silently clamps.
  Verify: cfg=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cst-ac3.XXXXXX"); err=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cst-ac3-err.XXXXXX"); printf 'migration:\n  call_site_threshold: 0\n' > "$cfg"; ( source plugins/dso/hooks/lib/planning-config.sh; WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$cfg" get_call_site_threshold >/dev/null 2>"$err" ); rc=$?; test "$rc" -ne 0 && test -s "$err"; status=$?; rm -f "$cfg" "$err"; exit $status
- [ ] Test file carries the executable bit.
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/tests/hooks/lib/test-planning-config-call-site-threshold.sh

## File Impact
- Edit: plugins/dso/hooks/lib/planning-config.sh
- Create: plugins/dso/tests/hooks/lib/test-planning-config-call-site-threshold.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Add get_call_site_threshold() helper to planning-config.sh (default + floor + non-silent rejection)
